Generate documentation for the repository: README.md, YAML API reference, and
classification workflow docs. Delegates each sub-task to the YAML runtime interpreter.

### Run Operations

#### Python

_No operation description provided._

```python
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] if "__file__" in dir() else Path(".").resolve()
INTERPRETER = REPO_ROOT / "02_core" / "runtimes" / "yaml" / "interpreter.py"
WORKFLOWS_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "06_workflows"
TEMPLATES_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "14_templates"

def _run(yaml_file: Path, def_id: str, mode: str, extra: list) -> int:
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(INTERPRETER), str(yaml_file), def_id, f"--mode={mode}", *extra]
    print(f"$ {' '.join(cmd)}", flush=True)
    return subprocess.call(cmd, cwd=REPO_ROOT)

argv = sys.argv[1:] if hasattr(sys, "argv") else []
mode = "check" if "--check" in argv else "write"

readme_rc = _run(WORKFLOWS_DIR / "docs.readme.generate.workflow.yaml", "docs.readme.generate.workflow", mode, [])
if readme_rc != 0:
    sys.exit(readme_rc)
classification_rc = _run(
    WORKFLOWS_DIR / "docs.classification.render.workflow.yaml", "docs.classification.render.workflow",
    mode, ["--output_dir=18_docs"],
)
if classification_rc != 0:
    sys.exit(classification_rc)
api_rc = _run(WORKFLOWS_DIR / "docs.api.reference.workflow.yaml", "docs.api.reference.workflow", mode, ["--output_dir=18_docs"])
sys.exit(api_rc)

```
